contexts.text: From (the Most Ancient Church) emanated the phrase, which became customary, that, from the affection of good, the Church itself was called daughter, and also virgin... and wife.
The fruits thence derived, which are of truth, are called sons; and the fruits which are of good, daughters.
From the heavenly and angelic proprium, the Church is called in the Word, woman, wife, bride, virgin, daughter.

Sons and daughters = the truths and goods which they perceived; sons, truths; and daughters, goods; for the conceptions and births of the Church, in the Word, as of old, are called sons and daughters. Illustrated.
Thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side (); sons = truths; and daughters, goods.

Deliver me and snatch me from the hand of strange sons, whose mouth speaketh vanity; our sons are as great plantations made in their childhood; our daughters as corners, cut out in the form of a temple (): strange sons = spurious or false truths; our sons = the doctrinal things of truth; daughters, the doctrinal things of good. SE 4140:end.
I will say to the north, Give; and to the south wind, Keep not back; bring My sons from far, and My daughters from the extremity of the earth (): sons = truths; daughters, goods. AC 1458:2.
Sons and daughters () = truths and goods.

Daughters = goods many times in the Word; as in David: The daughters of kings among thy precious ones... The daughter of Tyre for a gift, the king's daughter is all-glorious within (); where the good and beauty of love and faith are described by daughter: hence Churches are called daughters, and that from goods; as the daughter of Sion, and the daughter of Jerusalem. They are also called daughters of the people (); the daughter of Tharshish (); the daughter of Sidon (); daughters in the field ().

The same things are signified by sons and daughters in this chapter (); but such as the Church is, such are the sons and daughters, or the goods and truths: here, they = the truths and goods which they distinctly perceived, because they are predicated of the Most Ancient Church, which was the principal and parent of the other and succeeding ones. AC 532.
Under Cupidity, see this reference.

Daughters () = the things belonging to the will of that man, thus cupidities... Daughters, or goods, belong to the will; but such as the man is, such is the understanding and such the will, thus such are the sons and daughters. It here treats of a corrupt man, who has no will, but mere cupidity instead, which they suppose to be, and also call, will...

The reason daughters = the things of the will, and, when there is no will, cupidities; and the reason sons = the things of the understanding, and, when there is no understanding of truth, phantasies, is that the female sex is of such a nature, and is so formed, that will or cupidity reigns above understanding; such is the whole disposition of their fibres; such is their nature. But the male sex is so formed, that understanding or reason reigns; such, too, is the disposition of their fibres; such is their nature...

The sons of God saw the daughters of man, that they were good, and took them wives of all whom they chose () = that the doctrinal things of faith conjoined themselves with cupidities; with any whatever.
(Shem) begat sons and daughters () = doctrinal things. AC 1338.
(Arphaxad) begat sons and daughters () = doctrinal things.
(Shelah) begat sons and daughters () = doctrinal things.
(Eber) begat sons and daughters () = doctrinal things which are rituals.
They will bring thy sons in the bosom, and thy daughters shall be carried on the shoulder (): daughters = goods; sons, truths.
Under Affection of good, see these references. AC 3024:2. AC 3066. AC 3067. AC 3834. AC 3848. AC 4134. AC 4177. AC 4200. AC 4215. AC 4643.
Daughters () = the affections of good and truth; or, what is the same, those who are in these affections. AC 2400. AC 2407.

(Lot's) two daughters with him () = its affections in like manner (impure). Daughters = affections; but such as the good is, such are the affections; even spurious and impure good has its affections... AC 2465.

(Lot's) two daughters = the affections thence derived, which are of such good and such falsity: the good from which the affections are, is Lot, and the truth from which they are, was Lot's wife. When this has become a statue of salt, that is, when the good of truth is vastated, then such good exists as is signified by Lot in the cave, and such affections therefrom as are signified by his daughters.
Daughters, and daughters-in-law () = such affections.
As whoredom has such a signification, and daughters = affections, it was so severely forbidden that a priest's daughter should commit whoredom ().
Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy ()... Sons = truths themselves; daughters, goods themselves. References.
Under Cook, see this reference.
Under Affection, see this reference.

Hence it is evident that the daughters of the gentiles, the daughters of the Philistines, the daughters of Egypt, the daughters of Tyre and Sidon, the daughters of Edom, the daughters of Moab, the daughters of the Chaldeans, and of Babel, the daughters of Sodom, = affections of evil and falsity, from which come these religiosities; thus, they = the religiosities themselves. Illustrated. AC 4335.
The daughters of the magnificent nations () = affections of evil.
The daughter of Egypt () = the affection of reasoning about the truths of faith, whether it is so, from scientifics; thus, she = the religiosity which thence originates...

It is evident that in these passages daughters do not mean daughters, but affections which disagree with truth; thus, the religiosities thence derived; (and what these are is determined by the signification of the various nations mentioned).
The king's daughter () = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; her friends, the virgins after her = affections of truth. AC 5044:13.
The daughters of Zion who uplift themselves () = affections of evil within the Church.
Whose daughter art thou? () = further exploration concerning innocence. Explained.

I loathe my life, on account of the daughters of Heth () = the adjunction of natural truth from another source... The daughters of Heth = affections of truth from what is not genuine; here, of natural truth, because it is said concerning Jacob. AC 3621.
If Jacob takes a woman from the daughters of Heth () = that natural truth was not to be associated with them.

As these, are the daughters of the land () = because not from this ground, that is, from the truths of the genuine Church. Daughters = Churches; for daughters = the affections of good and truth; and the land, the tract where the Church is, thus, the Church: thus, the daughters of the land = the goods and truths of the Church.
Thou shalt not take a woman from the daughters of Canaan () = that it should not be conjoined with affections of falsity and evil... Daughters = affections. References. AC 3665. AC 3683.

Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were evil in the eyes of Isaac his father () = the foresight and providence of the Lord that the affections of that truth with which natural good had heretofore been conjoined, would not conduce to conjunction... The daughters of Canaan, here, the daughters of Heth = the affections of truth from what is not genuine. Explained.

Father = good; and mother, truth; in fact, that good and truth from which come the lower or derivative goods and truths, which are relatively as daughters and sons; and are therefore called daughters and sons in the Word. AC 3703:15, Illustrated. AC 3908. AC 4835:3. AC 4843. HH 382. AE 166.
The king's daughter = the love of truth... because it treats here of the Lord and His Divine Human. AC 5954:7. AC 9688:end. AC 9942:7.
The daughter of a priest = the affection of good.

Laban represents the good of a common, but collateral stock... Hence the daughters from that good, (Rachel and Leah), represent affections in the Natural; for these are as daughters from that good as a father.
The two daughters of Laban () = the affections of truth from the good of a common stock. Daughters = affections; here, the affections of truth from the good represented by Laban.
I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter () = assiduity, and subsequently a holy state in order to be conjoined with internal truth.
In my happiness because the daughters will make me happy () = the delight of the affections which corresponds to the happiness of eternal life... The daughters who will make happy = Churches.
Afterwards she bare a daughter () = the affection of all (the general truths), and also the Church of a faith in which is good, (that is, the Spiritual Church). Explained.
Thou hast not permitted me to kiss my sons and my daughters () = disjunction in consequence of a free state according to the faith of this good... Sons = truths; and daughters, goods.

The daughters are my daughters, and the sons are my sons, and the flock is my flock () = that all the affections of truth, and all the truths and goods were his. Daughters, here those of Rachel and Leah, = the affections of truth. AC 4215.
And to my daughters, what shall I do to them this day, or to their sons whom they have borne? () = that he dare not claim them. Daughters = affections of truth.
To see the daughters of the land () = to Know the affections of truth and the Churches thence derived.
The daughters of the land = the Churches among the ancients. Everywhere in the Word, in the internal sense, daughters = Churches.
To love and betroth the daughter of a strange God () = to conjoin one's self with falsity, in place of truth, which is the wife of the youth.
Sons () = truths; and daughters, their affections.
Give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you () = the union of goods and truths... Daughters = affections, thus goods. AC 4483.
We will take our daughter and go () = that there is no conjunction. Explained.

As kings represented the Lord as to Divine truth... their daughters were clothed in coats of various colours; for by daughters were signified the affections of good and truth, and thence Churches. AC 9942:8.
And all his daughters () = those who are in evils. Daughters = goods, and, in the opposite sense, evils; or, those who are in goods or evils. References.
Judah saw there the daughter of a man, a Canaanite () = the affection of evil from the falsity of evil... Daughter = the affection of good; and, in the opposite sense, the affection of evil.
The life of evil is signified by the daughters committing whoredom (); and the doctrine of falsity from which is the life of evil, by the daughters-in-law committing adultery.

The daughter rising up against her mother () = that the affection of evil does so against truth; and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law = that the affection of falsity does so against good. AC 4843:5. AC 4843:end.

He gave him Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On for a woman () = the quality of the marriage of truth with good, and of good with truth... The daughter of the priest of On = the truth of good; for daughter = the affection of truth; and a priest = good.
His daughters and his sons' daughters () = goods in order. Daughters = goods; and so also do sons' daughters, but the goods which are from the former, thus in their order.

He that loveth son and daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me (). Father and mother, here = those things in general which are of man's proprium from heredity; and son and daughter, those things which are of man's proprium from actuality.
The daughter of Zion () = the affection of good, which is of the Celestial Church.
Of a daughter, she marcheth upon the wall () = to fight against falsity. A daughter = the Church; here, the Spiritual Church, because that is treated of.
Daughters () = affections.
If she be a daughter, even let her live () = not (to be destroyed) if it is good... for, when the infernals infest, they are allowed to assault truths, but not goods. Explained.

The daughter of Pharaoh went down () = the religiosity there. Daughter = the affection of truth and of good, and thence the Church; but, in the opposite sense, the affection of falsity and of evil, and thence the religiosity which is from them; here, the religiosity from false scientifics, because it is the daughter of Pharaoh. AC 6739.
That daughters, in the Word, = Churches; and also that daughters = the religiosities of many nations, which are false. Illustrated.

The daughter of Egypt () = the affection of reasoning concerning the truths of faith, whether it is so, from scientifics, when the Negative reigns; thus = the religiosity which thence originates; and which is of such a character that nothing is believed except what is false.
The daughters which are earned by nurses at thy side () = the goods which are continually being insinuated; for daughters = good; and nurses, those things which insinuate.
The daughter of My people is cruel () = the Spiritual Church; here, vastated.

She brought him to the daughter of Pharaoh () = to the affection of scientifics. The daughter of Pharaoh = a religiosity; but here, the affection of scientifics; for it is the third state which is described in this verse, and, in that case, daughter = affection; and Pharaoh, what is scientific in general; thus, the daughter of Pharaoh = the affection of scientifics. Explained.

The priest of Midian had seven daughters () = the holy things of that Church. The daughters of a priest = the things of the Church; daughter = the Church; priest, the good of love; thus, the daughters of a priest = the Church as to good: Midian = those who are in the truths of simple good; and seven = what is holy; thus, the priest of Midian had seven daughters = the holy things of the Church belonging to those who are in the truths of simple good.

He said to his daughters () = thought concerning the holy things of the Church. Daughters = the holy things of the Church; the holy things which are here signified by daughters are truths, which, in the Word, are called holy...
He gave Zipporah his daughter to Moses () = that he adjoined to him the good of his own Church... Daughter = good, and also the Church; Zipporah = the quality of the good of that Church.
Ye shall put them on your sons and your daughters () = application to their truths and to their goods. Sons = truths; and daughters, goods.

With our sons and with our daughters () = those who are in the affection of truth and in the affection of good. Sons = the truths of the Church, thus affections, because truths without affections are not anything; and daughters = goods, thus, the affections of good.
The daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church. AE 176:end.

Thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, etc. () = Heaven and happiness for each and all things in the internal and external of man... Thou = the man himself; son, his Intellectual; daughter, his Voluntary, both in the internal man... The reason son = the Intellectual, is that son = truth, for truths constitute the Intellectual; and the reason daughter = the Voluntary, is that daughter = good, for goods constitute the Voluntary.
Daughters () = goods.
If she bear him sons and daughters () = truths and goods thence derived. Sons = truths; and daughters, goods.
When a man has sold his daughter for a maidservant () = the affection of truth from natural delight. The daughter of a man = the affection of truth; for daughter = affection; and man, truth.

They who are in the genuine affection of truth, in the representative sense, are the daughters of the men of the Israelites; but they who are in an affection of truth which is not genuine, are maidservants from the daughters of Israel.

According to the judgment of daughters shall he do to her () = that it shall be as is the genuine affection of truth... Daughter = the affection of truth; here, the genuine affection of truth; for a maidservant = the affection of truth from natural delight; thus not genuine before she is betrothed...

Or shall have gored a son or a daughter () = a reviling by the affection of evil against the truths and goods of faith derived from interior things... Son = the truth of faith; and daughter, the good of faith: the reason they = truths and goods derived from interior things, is that interior things are like parents, from which goods and truths are born like sons and daughters. Explained.

Sons from afar = those who are in obscurity as to truths; daughters from the extremity of the earth = those who are in obscurity as to goods, such as are the gentiles. Sons = those who are in truths, and, in the abstract sense, truths; daughters, those who are in goods, and, in the abstract sense, goods. References.
The daughter of My people () = the Church.
The daughter of a priest married to a strange man shall not eat () = that the holy things of the Church cannot be appropriated to the good which is not conjoined with the truths of the Church.

The daughter of Tyre shall offer thee a gift (): the Church as to the affection of truth is here described, and is called the king's daughter; for daughter = the Church as to affection; and king, truth. AE 236:5.

Pull out the earrings of gold from the ears of your women, of your sons, and of your daughters () = the drawing out of such things from the sense of the letter of the Word as favour external loves, and the principles thence derived... Daughters = the affections of truth and good, and, consequently, in the opposite sense, the affections of falsity and of evil.

The daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law () The daughter = the affection of good and of truth; the mother, the affection of evil and of falsity; the daughter-in-law = the truth of the Church adjoined to its good; and the mother-in-law, falsity adjoined to its evil. AC 10490:5.
If thou take of his daughters for thy sons () = the conjunction of the affections of evil with truths... Daughters = the affections of good; and, in the opposite sense, the affections of evil.

And his daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods () = thus the profanation of good and of truth... His daughters, or those of the inhabitant of the land, = the affections of evil. Explained.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] Daughters = the affections of good, thus goods. References.
The Israelitish and Jewish Churches are here treated of, which are the daughters of one mother (). AR 134:4. AE 141:4. AE 555:7.
The king's daughter = the Church as to the affection of truth.
The daughters of the owl, etc. () = various concupiscences.
A daughter, in the Word, = the good of doctrine, also the will and thence the affection of truth and of good.
To eat the flesh of sons and daughters () = to destroy truths and goods with one's self: sons = truths; and daughters, goods. References.

The offspring from the Lord as a Husband and Father, and from the Church as a wife and mother, are all spiritual; and in the spiritual sense of the Word are meant by sons and daughters, etc. General article.

Hence sons and daughters in the spiritual sense of the Word, mean truths and goods; sons, truths conceived in the spiritual man and born in the natural man; and daughters, in like manner, goods... As daughters = the goods of the Church, there is so frequently mentioned in the Word the daughter of Zion, of Jerusalem, of Israel, and of Judah, by which are not meant any daughters, but the affection of good which is of the Church.

The offspring born from two who are in love truly conjugial derive from their parents the marriage principle of good and truth, whereby they have an inclination and capacity, if sons, to perceive the things of wisdom, and if daughters, to love the things which wisdom teaches. General article.
Sons and daughters () = the affections of truth and of good.
The king's daughter = the spiritual affection of truth, and thence the Church from those who are in that affection. AE 242:21. AE 298:7. AE 412:26. AE 684:18.
The daughters of Zion () = the Celestial Church, and the things of that Church; here, perverted.
Of a daughter () = those who are in evils, and want to destroy goods by means of falsities.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church.
The daughter of My people () = the Church.

The king's daughters that were virgins () = the affections of truth, and thence the Church, as may be evident from a thousand places in the Word where are mentioned the daughter of a king, the daughter of Zion, and the daughter of Jerusalem... wherefore, also, the daughters of a king represented the truths of that affection by their garments, and, in general, by their mantles, which were variegated with pieces.
Which devoureth thy sons and thy daughters () = all spiritual affections of truth and of good.
The daughter of Tyre = the affection of the Knowledges of truth and of good.
The daughters who will make happy = the spiritual affections of truth which constitute the Church, and from which comes all internal happiness that is heavenly. Explained.
Of a daughter, she marcheth upon the wall = to fight from the truths which are from good against the falsities which are from evil.
The daughters of Judah which shall exult () = the affections of good and of truth which appertain to those who belong to the Celestial Church.
The mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother () = the cupidity of falsity against the affection of truth; and the reverse. AE 724:6.

Dragons and the daughters of the owl () = those who know truths and goods only from memory, and do not understand and perceive them; these speak truth without having any idea of it, being entirely dependent upon others.
The daughter of the Chaldeans () = the falsification of truth.
The mother () = the truth of the Church; and the daughter, its good.
The sons and daughters whom they bare () = the falsities and evils of the Church.
To sacrifice sons and daughters () = to destroy the truths and goods of the Church by evil cupidities; sons = the truths of the Church; and daughters, its goods.
The daughters of the owl = the affections of falsity.

The consumption of all truth and good is signified by they shall eat the flesh of their sons and daughters (). Sons = the truths of the Church, and, in the opposite sense, its falsities; and daughters = the affections of truth and of good, and, in the opposite sense, the cupidities of falsity and of evil; their mutual consumption and extinction is signified by eating them.
Thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword () = that the truths and goods of the Church will perish by means of the falsities of evil.
The daughters of Zion, and the virgins of Jerusalem () = those in the Church who are in the affection of good and of truth; and, abstractedly, these affections themselves.
The daughters of the owl = sensuous affections, for the Sensual is affected with and sees truths in the darkness, as an owl sees objects in the night.
The daughters that were haughty () = the cupidities which are of (self-love).
The daughter of Egypt = the affection of falsity which belongs to such a Church.
Sons and daughters () = the truths and goods of the Church which they will destroy. AE 654:70.
To commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab () = to adulterate the goods of the Church.
Sons and daughters () = exterior truths and goods; mothers and fathers, interior truths and goods...
The daughter of the Chaldeans = the profanation of truth.
Owls = those who see falsities as truths; and their daughters, the concupiscences of falsifying truths. AE 714:20.

Our daughters () = the affections of truth; which are therefore compared to corners cut out in the figure of a palace, because a palace is the representative of the understanding, in which truths are in their beautiful form, and they are in a beautiful form when they are from the affection of truth.

Sons from afar, and daughters from the extremity of the earth: sons = those who are in truths; and daughters, those who are in the affection of them; and, therefore, abstractedly from persons, they = truths and the affections of them.

That all truths together with the affections of them will perish through falsities is signified by your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword (): sons = truths; daughters, the affections of truth.
The Church which is in genuine truths is meant by the daughter of Zion ().
Thy sons are carried off into captivity, and thy daughters into captivity () = that the truths and goods of their Church are shut off by falsities and evils; sons = truths; and daughters, goods.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church in which the Lord reigns through Divine truth. AE 1175:2.
Under Virgin, see this reference.

King's daughters () = the affections of Divine truth... The daughter of Tyre shall send a gift () = worship by those who are in the Knowledges of truth... The king's daughter is all glorious within () = the spiritual affection of truth, which is called glorious from the abundance of truth, and within = what is spiritual.
Harvest and bread () = the truths and goods of the Church nourishing; sons and daughters, the same producing.
Careless daughters () = those in the Church who love falsities more than truths.
The daughter of Judah () = the Church from the doctrine of truth from the Word.
